title: Ten Moves, Then Farewell
summary: Xiao Yan visits the Rock Gate with Medusa and tells Wu Hao and Hu Jia he is going back to the Jia Ma Empire. Zi Yan insists on coming, and he agrees, then refines pills for the members and asks that Rock Gate graduates be sent to the Xiao Gate. Lin Yan brings Lin Xiu Ya and Liu Qing, who will follow him to the Misty Cloud Sect if he beats them both, and Xiao Yan wins within ten moves. Yao Lao urges him to fuse three Heavenly Flames into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, and after many days of practice he starts to make progress. When Xiao Li sends word that everything is ready, Xiao Yan says goodbye to Su Qian and his friends at the academy. He then joins the Xiao Gate and its Black-Corner allies, gathered to set off.

cultivation: Lin Xiu Ya and Liu Qing are Dou Wang elders. Xiao Yan can only start the second seal after reaching Dou Huang. Wu Hao and Hu Jia are not yet Dou Wangs. The Xiao Gate has eight Dou Wangs.
